{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import subprocess
import json

notebook_id = '4c5c9eee-df32-45ca-a7bc-5a8d3648120b'

try:
    with open('urls.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-16') as f:
        all_urls = [line.strip('\ufeff').strip() for line in f if line.strip()]
    original_300 = [u for u in all_urls if u.startswith('http')][:300]
except Exception as e:
    exit(1)

res = subprocess.run(['notebooklm', 'source', 'list', '-n', notebook_id, '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(res.stdout)
current_urls = [source.get('url') for source in data.get('sources', []) if source.get('url')]

missing_urls = list(set(original_300) - set(current_urls))
for u in missing_urls:
    print(u)
"","Cwd":"C:\Users\renu5\.gemini\antigravity\scratch","WaitMsBeforeAsync":5000,"toolAction":"Fetching missing URLs list","toolSummary":"Fetch missing URLs"}
